name: Structured Data
description: Detects JSON-LD (and, as a fallback, Microdata/RDFa) on the page and awards tiered points for schema.org types that AI answer engines use most (FAQPage above all, then HowTo/Product/Organization, then Article/VideoObject/Dataset, then BreadcrumbList/ItemList/Person). Machine-readable entities let AI systems extract facts and Q&A pairs without guessing from prose.
inputs: rendered DOM: every <script type="application/ld+json"> element (text content)
rendered DOM: [itemscope] elements and their itemtype attribute (Microdata)

scoring.summary: Page scope, run on every page. If there is no JSON-LD script, no [itemscope] and no [typeof]/[vocab] element the check scores 0. If no JSON-LD block parses (none present, or all broken) but Microdata/RDFa exists, it is a fixed 4. If every block is broken and there is no Microdata/RDFa, 0. If the only JSON-LD is template-built and unparseable from source, 8 (inconclusive). Otherwise points are summed (plugin scale): base 4 (at least one block parses); main types (HowTo, Product, Organization family, Article family, VideoObject, Dataset): the first valid one 7, each further valid one 2, or 2 once when main types are present but none validates; FAQPage 8 valid / 4 only invalid; each supporting type (BreadcrumbList, ItemList, Person, and WebSite when it has a name or url) 1 if valid. BreadcrumbList is suggested on inner pages, WebSite on the homepage. Total = min(15, Math.round(sum)); if template-built blocks could not be parsed and the total is below 8, it is raised to 8 and marked inconclusive. Every typed node at any depth (including @graph and nested objects) counts; a type is valid when at least one of its nodes validates with lib/schema-validator.mjs. Status comes from the engine (>= 12 pass, >= 8 warning).

rules.condition: count(script[type="application/ld+json"]) == 0 AND count([itemscope]) == 0 AND count([typeof]) == 0 AND count([vocab]) == 0
no JSON-LD block parses (zero blocks, or every block has invalid JSON) AND (Microdata found OR RDFa found)
rules.note: Fixed 4 regardless of Microdata/RDFa types or validity. Microdata types = itemtype matched by /schema\.org\/(\w+)/ (else raw itemtype). RDFa types = typeof split on whitespace. RDFa 'found' needs [typeof] or [vocab]; [property] alone (e.g. OpenGraph meta property=) does NOT count.

rules.condition: JSON-LD present: parse each script textContent with JSON.parse (template tags substituted first, see divergences); parse failures are reported as findings
base: at least one JSON-LD block parsed successfully

main types: @type in HowTo, Product, Organization family (Organization, LocalBusiness, ...), Article family (Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, TechArticle), VideoObject, Dataset; a bucket is valid when one of its own nodes validates
rules.points: +7 for the first valid main bucket, +2 for each further valid one; +2 once if main buckets are present but none is valid

rules.condition: FAQ: any entity with @type FAQPage; valid if the validator passes
rules.note: A bonus: recommended only when the page shows 2 or more questions (h2-h5, summary or dt text ending in ?).

rules.condition: supporting types: BreadcrumbList, ItemList, Person (nested author objects count), WebSite (plugin: counts when it has a name or url; it has no validator, so structured-data.valid is unchanged)
any other @type (WebPage, Question, Answer, ListItem, ImageObject, etc.)
total
validator FAQPage: mainEntity must be an array (else invalid). Each item: @type === 'Question', has name, has acceptedAnswer with @type === 'Answer' and non-empty text
validator HowTo: name required; step must be an array; HowToSection items are expanded into their itemListElement steps; at least 2 steps; each step @type HowToStep and has text or name
validator Product: name, image, description required; offers required; each offer needs price (0 allowed), priceRange or lowPrice AND priceCurrency; if aggregateRating present it needs ratingValue
validator Organization (all subtypes): only name required (url/logo/sameAs/address/telephone/openingHours are warnings only)

validator Article types: headline required; author required (if first author is an object, after @id resolution, it needs name; a string author is only a warning); datePublished required and must be ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD with optional time)
validator Person: name required
validator BreadcrumbList: itemListElement must be an array; each item needs truthy position and name or item.name
validator ItemList: itemListElement must be an array (nothing else required)
validator VideoObject: name, description, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate (ISO 8601) required
validator Dataset: name and description required
JSON-LD only template-built and unparseable from source (no parseable block, no broken block, no Microdata/RDFa)
rules.note: inconclusive; verify on the built or live page

scoring.status_mapping: Engine rule on the integer score: >= 80% (12) pass, >= 50% (8) warning, else fail. Same thresholds as the extension.

detect.source_procedure: Script checks/structured-data/present.mjs runs on every HTML page the site model loads (built output or static HTML). It uses lib/jsonld.mjs extractJsonLd(doc, { templates: true }) to parse blocks (template tags substituted) and collect every typed node, lib/schema-validator.mjs validateNodes to validate them, and [itemscope] / [typeof] / [vocab] for the Microdata/RDFa fallback. For unbuilt framework sources, build first; JSON-LD injected at runtime (tag managers, client-side React) is not visible.

parity.note: Exact when JSON-LD is literal in HTML or when the built output can be scanned. Differs when JSON-LD is assembled at runtime (client-side injection by GTM, Yoast/Rank Math style CMS plugins, React state), built from CMS data or template variables that cannot be resolved statically (validity of name/headline/datePublished then unknown), or injected per-route in SPAs. Extension evaluates one URL; source audit may cover many templates.

fix_summary: Add a JSON-LD <script type="application/ld+json"> block in the shared head/layout (Organization with name/url/logo/sameAs on every page; WebSite) and page-type blocks (Article/BlogPosting with headline, author {Person name}, datePublished; FAQPage only where visible Q&A exists; BreadcrumbList). Goes in index.html / Astro layout / Hugo partial / Eleventy _includes / Next.js layout.tsx or page.tsx. Skeletons can be generated automatically, but real names, FAQ content, prices and dates need user data.

divergences.extension: If every JSON-LD block fails to parse, the Microdata/RDFa fallback is skipped and the score is 0 even when Microdata exists.
divergences.plugin: Broken JSON-LD does not hide Microdata/RDFa: the fixed 4 applies whenever no JSON-LD block parses.
divergences.reason: Bug: a syntax error in one block wiped out credit for valid Microdata.

divergences.extension: @type must match exactly, so full IRIs like "https://schema.org/Organization" fall into Other.
divergences.plugin: A leading http(s)://schema.org/ is stripped before matching.
divergences.reason: Full IRIs are valid JSON-LD for the same type.

divergences.extension: isValidISO8601 is new Date(x) not NaN, so strings like "March 3, 2024" pass as ISO 8601.
divergences.plugin: datePublished and uploadDate must have the ISO 8601 shape (YYYY-MM-DD with optional time and zone) and parse as a date.
divergences.reason: The issue text says ISO 8601; the code accepted non-ISO dates (comment/code mismatch).

divergences.extension: HowTo steps must all be @type HowToStep; HowToSection groups make the HowTo invalid.
divergences.plugin: HowToSection steps are accepted and their itemListElement HowToStep items are validated and counted.
divergences.reason: HowToSection is valid schema.org and Google-supported; the extension penalized normal markup.

divergences.extension: Offer price 0 counts as missing (falsy check); AggregateOffer lowPrice is not accepted; aggregateRating ratingValue 0 is missing.
divergences.plugin: price 0, lowPrice and ratingValue 0 count as present.
divergences.reason: Free products and AggregateOffer are valid; falsy checks flagged normal content.

divergences.extension: Only the properties mainEntity, itemListElement, acceptedAnswer, author, publisher have pure {"@id"} references resolved, against @graph items and top-level objects.
divergences.plugin: Validators resolve pure {"@id"} references (also for HowTo step and offers) against any node on the page that defines that @id.
divergences.reason: Same intent (Yoast/Rank Math @graph pattern), applied consistently.

divergences.extension: A typed reference such as publisher {"@type": "Organization", "@id": "#org"} is validated on its own and is invalid for lacking name, even when #org is fully defined on the page.
divergences.plugin: When the same @id is defined more fully elsewhere on the page, the typed reference is not validated separately; the full definition is. Unresolvable references are still validated (extension behaviour).

divergences.extension: Reads the rendered page, where template tags are already filled in.
divergences.plugin: Reads HTML from the repo. JSON-LD holding template tags ({{ }}, {% %}, <% %>, <? ?>) is parsed with the tags replaced by a placeholder that counts as a present value; the result is marked predicted. A block that still cannot be parsed is never counted as a JSON error: the check reports inconclusive with partial credit and asks for a build or a live check.
divergences.reason: Source vs live: template values are unknown in the repo, and unrendered syntax is not a real error.

divergences.plugin: Runs on every page; the engine aggregates per-page scores and groups identical findings.
divergences.reason: Source audit covers the whole site.

divergences.extension: Tier points: FAQPage 8, HowTo/Product/Organization 3 each, Article/VideoObject/Dataset 2 each, BreadcrumbList/ItemList/Person 1 each; a page without FAQPage tops out around 11 and cannot pass.
divergences.plugin: The first valid main type earns 7 and each further one 2, so Organization plus BreadcrumbList (inner pages) or Organization plus WebSite (homepage) passes (12). FAQPage stays worth 8 as a bonus and is only recommended on pages that visibly show questions.
divergences.reason: FAQPage only fits pages with visible Q&A; requiring it everywhere scored down About, Contact and listing pages with complete, valid schema.
